summary: Domain exploration for the agentic chat workbench: full Domain Map across all seven dimensions, 8-entry anti-default ledger with alternatives, and 4 structurally distinct creative territories with no thesis selected.

claims.claim: Domain Map covers objects and instruments of agentic coding chat including Write/Read/Edit/Bash/WebSearch trace, composer steering, and three verification views.
Domain Map covers materials and light, environments and spatial relationships, practitioner vocabulary and metaphors, natural colors, rhythms over time, and task pressure.
Anti-default ledger names 8 category defaults each with why-likely, when-right, and one alternative mechanism.
Ledger alternatives satisfy hard floors for tool-trace visibility, real loading/empty/error states, and responsive three-pane behavior.
Creative Opportunities opens 4 materially different territories differing on compositional model, density, motion role, surface logic, and typographic voice.
No thesis is selected in this phase; all territories remain open for direction-divergence under full autonomy.

decisions.choice: Select no thesis; carry all four territories open into direction-divergence.
rationale: Packet non-goals forbid visual Direction decisions in this phase; divergence phase needs open territories.
alternatives: Select a thesis in this phase

decisions.choice: Treat summary-first trace rows with Tier-3 detail as the working contract for later candidates.
rationale: Brief T5/T7 plus hard floors require visible trace and real states; structures the specimen plan.
alternatives: Leave trace structure open for each Direction

decisions.choice: Treat left resumption wing and right per-session evidence wing as architectural, with collapse rules owned by each Direction.
rationale: Brief T2/T4 plus C-T6/C-P3 force session-scoped wings with specified collapse rules at every width.
alternatives: Let each Direction redefine sidebar scope

risks: r-reading-drown: Dense tool trace and dual sidebars drown the central reading column. Mitigation: Tier discipline plus density axes in opportunities keep Tier-1 reading calm under workbench density.

r-streaming-theater: Streaming and skeleton motion becomes decorative theater that fatigues sustained operators. Mitigation: Distinct prose-caret vs tool-skeleton states with reduced-motion fallbacks and sub-300ms echo.

r-narrow-collapse: Three-pane architecture fails at 375px through crushed measure or horizontal scroll. Mitigation: Each Territory carries explicit collapse semantics; specimens must prove 375px single column with reachable composer.

r-false-trust: Calm surfaces over-signal trust and hide failures, retries, or empty-trace turns. Mitigation: Ledger contract requires every work-claiming turn to carry tool evidence or an explicit empty-trace state.
